Name: The Revenants - Corridor of Souls
Description: An action game fought through a corridor of souls.

Achievements.Name: Banish
Achievements.Description: Capture 5 or more enemies in a single vortex.

Achievements.Name: Anura
Achievements.Description: Capture a frog with its tongue fully extended.

Achievements.Name: It's a Trap!
Achievements.Description: Create a vortex that encircles no enemies, but captures 5 or more.

Achievements.Name: Lucky 13
Achievements.Description: Capture 13 enemies, one at a time, with 13 sequential vortexes.

Achievements.Name: Synchronicity
Achievements.Description: Capture 3 or more enemies in each of 3 simultaneous vortexes.

Achievements.Name: Exterminator
Achievements.Description: Capture 15 or more enemies in a single vortex.

Achievements.Name: Spiritus
Achievements.Description: Survive an entire level without a single death.

Achievements.Name: Exorcist
Achievements.Description: Capture 30 or more enemies in a single vortex.

Achievements.Name: Omnivore
Achievements.Description: Capture 5 or more different enemy types in a single vortex.

Achievements.Name: Easy Street Millionaire
Achievements.Description: Score 1,000,000 or more points on Easy difficulty.

Achievements.Name: Main Street Millionaire
Achievements.Description: Score 5,000,000 or more points on Normal difficulty.

Achievements.Name: Extreme Street Millionaire
Achievements.Description: Score 10,000,000 or more points on Hard difficulty.
